items.description: The aim of Food Care is to create a healthy service for clients interested to purchase web and mobile applications. The Food Care app offers resources from local dietitians targeted to a local community. The benefits of this app include connection to local restaurants, introduction to prepare healthy recipes, and personalization of a dietary plan.
Personalized healthy recipes in your inbox. Add items that you love to eat like Chinese, apples, or pancakes, and we'll email you a healthy recipe each day to make.
Helps image buyers more efficiently find images and image owners to sell them, by accepting payments for them and archiving licenses for public inspection.
Lists and maps thousands of restaurants, shops and hotels offering choices of menu and products for those on a gluten free, dairy free, nut free diet. Available in 3 languages.
Offers billing software for creating or modifying invoice reports and provides IE password recovery. Uses the US Postal Service API.
Mobigarages is a french iPhone app that uses the Allogarage API to help find auto garages that are reliable in a users area.
Malta hotels with integrated map of YouTube videos.
Bookflavor is a book discovery application which helps you taste books by showing reviews from many different sources.
Find celebrity videos, especially for Latin stars. Uses the YouTube API. Note that some videos are adult content and not safe for work, NSFW.

GoldenDict aims to create a feature-rich dictionary lookup program. Uses WebKit for an accurate article representation, complete with all formatting, colors, images and links. Supports multiple dictionary file formats. Support for Wikipedia, Wiktionary or any other MediaWiki-based sites. Ability to use arbitrary websites as dictionaries via templated Url patterns. Pronunciations from forvo.com and many more features.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.
www.jobsdbcenter.com is a jobs listing mashup site using indeed and google map API . we use also payscale for salary research.
A realtime map of Northern Lights locations and photos. See the current aurora forecast and latest Flickr and Twitter posts related to the Aurora Borealis.

HiDef offers more than 150,000 titles and features both new and hard to find Blue Ray and DVD movies. HiDef showcases FilmCrave movie reviews, trailers, ratings, and other information on their website to enhance the customer experience.
Our Sun Sign, Mind, Body and Yoga are all interconnected. Your Zodiac Sign, Health and Yoga is a Faceook app which helps to explore Health and Yoga based on Zodiac signs.
Collect and share all that makes your day fun and better.View daily best videos selected by You, your friends and others.

A lightweight language translation tool. Use the best translate service to translate between language pairs for Android-powered devices. Features: 30+ languages translation Auto detection Social Networking & SMS Share function Search translated text into preferred search engine (Google or Bing) Support tablet Translate selected texts from other apps (using Share) Save translated results
Check how good automated translations are. Enter a sentence and choose a language. The sentence is translated into the choosen language and afterwards retranslated back into the origin language.

Ford recruited 100 Agents to test drive their Ford Fiesta. These agents will spend 6 months with their own Fiesta, lifestreaming their experiences on YouTube/Twitter. This mashup maps out their tweets. So are they really doing their job?
CryptoCRIT is an open-source Cryptocurrency project which facilitates a Cryptocurrency wallet for making payments. The associated Cryptocurrency is called CritCoin.
Upload and share your GPS-Tracks. Over 13000 tracks for Mountain biking, Hiking, Biking, Climbing and others.
Shopping comparison service with local shopping focus. Search for national products and see availability at stores near you.
